description: Look up one identifier (a chunk, proof, match or transfer id, or a BSV txid) in ENYAL's public verify lookup; its verdict fields come back unchanged. Only `chain_confirmed:true` is a verified anchor; `degraded:true` means inconclusive, not absent. No auth.

identifier.description: The id to look up: a chunk_id, proof_id, match_id or transfer id (UUID), or a BSV transaction id (64 hex).

name: verify_proof
